versions.changelog:
- Added environment and binary requirements to metadata section in SKILL.md (now specifies that "python3" and certain env vars are required)
- Clarified API credential acquisition and environment variable setup instructions
- Improved preconditions and setup guidance for users
- No functional code or output logic modified; changes are documentation-only for easier integration and user clarity

- Updated version to 1.0.1.
- Documentation improvements in SKILL.md for clarity and completeness.
- No changes affecting user-visible features or tool behavior.

- 初始版本发布，支持深度企业百科报告自动生成
- 基于20+维度数据，自动识别主体类型并选择相应报告模板
- 适配企业、分支机构、个体户、医院、学校等多种主体
- 针对不同用户提问（如“了解一下”“怎么样”“靠不靠谱”）自适应重点内容
- 严格控制报告字数，多维度输出包括风险、信用、成长性等分析
- 全面环境变量校验和详细错误提示，避免信息遗漏
